archetype: rail freight depot with high-bay warehouse and dispatch offices
public_and_office_program: manager office, records room and rail-dispatch observation area
warehouse_program: high-bay floor beneath three sawtooth roof and clerestory bays
three south rail-loading apertures and two east truck docks
circulation: north road apron to public check-in and dispatch
dispatch through a controlled west door to warehouse receiving
three-wide warehouse cross and longitudinal aisles linking all process zones
warehouse to three rail doors and the raised rail platform
warehouse receiving to two east truck docks
dedicated stair to both upper office suites
damage_constraints: preserve the office annex, stair and office-to-warehouse connection
retain east truck receiving and at least two rail-loading bays
concentrate collapse in the west sawtooth bay and first rail door
shape rubble beneath the failed roof and expose fallen crane or roof members
derive all abandoned variants from the immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the building reads as a freight depot from road and rail approaches
road, truck and rail traffic systems remain distinct
warehouse storage, packing and receiving zones have usable clearances
the two office floors and dedicated stair are navigable at player scale
sawtooth roof, loading platform, docks and crane form a credible industrial system
damage preserves the original freight workflow and follows structural gravity
